triples.literal: owned entities whose identifier another owned entity also holds
Editing Policy Wiki W08 (line 63); DEC-015 as amended by Max on 2026-09-12 (literal identifiers exempt)

Two distinct owned entities in the validated module set never share an IRI-valued `dcterms:identifier`. IRI identifiers are compared as RDF terms; UUID URNs are compared without regard to hexadecimal letter case, so `urn:uuid:...AB...` and `urn:uuid:...ab...` are the same identifier. Literal identifiers (enumeration codes such as weekday numbers or currency codes, which are meaningful only within their own scheme) are outside this rule, as they were for the legacy validator. Repeated assertions of one identifier on the same entity are not a second holder, and superseded versions are never combined with the current set. Both holders of an exactly repeated identifier are reported; for a case-variant UUID the holder whose spelling contains uppercase letters is reported.
Another owned entity holds the same identifier.

SELECT $this ?value ?path WHERE {
            BIND ( dcterms:identifier AS ?path )
            $this dcterms:identifier ?value .
            FILTER ( isIRI(?value) )
            ?other dcterms:identifier ?otherId .
            ?other uoc:ownedBy ?otherModule .
            FILTER ( $this != ?other )
            FILTER ( ?otherId = ?value
                  || ( isIRI(?value) && isIRI(?otherId) && STRSTARTS(LCASE(STR(?value)), "urn:uuid:")
                       && LCASE(STR(?otherId)) = LCASE(STR(?value)) ) )
        }

triples.literal: Editing Policy Wiki W01 (lines 18-23); DEC-001; DEC-025; DEC-027

Each authored module document has one `owl:Ontology` header with exactly one IRI-valued `owl:versionIRI` and exactly one `owl:versionInfo`. The version info is a valid calendar date written `YYYY-MM-DD`; the final path segment of the version IRI (an existing trailing slash is allowed) is that date written `YYYYMMDD`. An optional `dcterms:modified` on the header has at most one value, an `xsd:date` written `YYYY-MM-DD` or `YYYY-MM-DDZ`, whose calendar date equals the version info; a numeric offset or an `xsd:dateTime` fails. Imported headers belong to other modules and never cause a false multiple-header result.
The owl:versionIRI ends in the owl:versionInfo date written YYYYMMDD.
The owl:versionInfo is a real calendar date.

SELECT $this ?value ?path WHERE {
            BIND ( owl:versionInfo AS ?path )
            $this owl:versionInfo ?value .
            FILTER ( REGEX(STR(?value), "^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$") )
            BIND ( xsd:integer(SUBSTR(STR(?value), 1, 4)) AS ?year )
            BIND ( xsd:integer(SUBSTR(STR(?value), 6, 2)) AS ?month )
            BIND ( xsd:integer(SUBSTR(STR(?value), 9, 2)) AS ?day )
            BIND ( IF ( ?month IN (1, 3, 5, 7, 8, 10, 12), 31,
                   IF ( ?month IN (4, 6, 9, 11), 30,
                   IF ( ?month = 2, IF ( (?year - 4 * FLOOR(?year / 4)) = 0 && ((?year - 100 * FLOOR(?year / 100)) != 0 || (?year - 400 * FLOOR(?year / 400)) = 0), 29, 28 ), 0 ) ) ) AS ?maximum )
            FILTER ( ?month < 1 || ?day < 1 || ?day > ?maximum )
        }
The header carries exactly one owl:versionInfo written YYYY-MM-DD.
The header carries exactly one IRI-valued owl:versionIRI.
An optional header dcterms:modified is a single xsd:date written YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDZ.
The header dcterms:modified date equals the owl:versionInfo date.

triples.literal: Editing Policy Wiki W11 (lines 84-90); DEC-003; DEC-013; DEC-014

At least one English `skos:prefLabel` corresponds to the entity's local name: after removing spaces and punctuation and comparing without regard to case, the label equals the local name (underscores removed) or the local name after an optional `PascalCase_` prefix. A leading digit in the label may be written as its English word, so `3D Model` and `Three D Model` both correspond to `ThreeDModel`, and `Red` corresponds to `Colour_Red`. Additional English spellings and other languages may differ freely: `Colour`@en-GB and `Color`@en-US may coexist on `Colour`.

SELECT $this WHERE {
            BIND ( REPLACE(STR($this), "^.*[/#]", "") AS ?local )
            BIND ( LCASE(REPLACE(?local, "_", "")) AS ?fullKey )
            BIND ( LCASE(REPLACE(REPLACE(?local, "^[A-Z][A-Za-z0-9]*_", ""), "_", "")) AS ?suffixKey )
            FILTER NOT EXISTS {
                $this skos:prefLabel ?label .
                FILTER ( LANGMATCHES(LANG(?label), "en") )
                BIND ( REPLACE(STR(?label), "[^A-Za-z0-9]", "") AS ?compact )
                BIND ( LCASE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(?compact,
                        "^0", "Zero"), "^1", "One"), "^2", "Two"), "^3", "Three"), "^4", "Four"),
                        "^5", "Five"), "^6", "Six"), "^7", "Seven"), "^8", "Eight"), "^9", "Nine")) AS ?key )
                FILTER ( ?key = ?fullKey || ?key = ?suffixKey )
            }
        }
